meta_description:
7,561 likes, 65 comments - techplusgadgets on September 27, 2026: "It’s a wrap on Meta Connect 2026 🎬

Three days at Menlo Park, front row for the keynote, and hands on everything before the world saw it.

What Zuck dropped:
👓 Meta VR Glasses — ultralight, just 100g on your face
🕶️ Ray-Ban Meta Gen 3 — new styles, out now
🎧 Ray-Ban Meta Audio — Meta’s first camera-free glasses
🔑 Muse Charm — the closing surprise nobody saw coming
🎤 Meta Glasses by Lisa — yes, that Lisa

Glasses are officially Meta’s biggest bet now. And I got to see it happen up close.

From Bhopal to Menlo Park thank you for making this possible ❤️ @meta @metaindia @muse 

#MetaConnect #TechPlusGadgets #AIGlasses #Meta #TechCreator".
